jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Solutions – Finance and Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

Ready to build your career? We want to hear from you.

Under the leadership of the Vice President, Integrated Management Systems, the Director, Enterprise Solutions – Finance and Operations is responsible for the strategy, evolution, operations, and value creation of the platforms that support Pomerleau’s finance functions and construction operations.

This mandate includes platforms that support accounting, payroll, accounts payable and receivable, procurement, project financial management, and construction operations. It encompasses both the operation and enhancement of current platforms, including CMiC and Procore, as well as the transformation associated with the deployment of the new financial system and the future PMIS.

The Director defines the portfolio roadmap, ensures business continuity throughout the transformation, and prepares the processes, data, integrations, teams, and operating model required to support future platforms.

Working closely with the Finance function and Construction business units, the Director translates business priorities into functional and technology capabilities, ensuring that platforms effectively meet organizational needs.

The Director leads the functional and technical teams, as well as external partners, responsible for platform evolution, integration, operations, and support. They are accountable for platform stability, performance, user adoption, and the value generated for the organization.

What you will do

Finance And Construction Operations

Act as the owner of the portfolio of platforms supporting Finance functions and Construction Operations.
Be accountable for the satisfaction of Finance functions and Construction business units with respect to the capabilities provided.
Understand challenges related to accounting, payroll, accounts payable and receivable, procurement, project financial management, and construction execution in order to guide priorities.
Ensure that business functions and operating sectors have the platforms, data, and processes required to achieve their objectives.
Continuously measure and improve the value generated by the platforms.

Portfolio Strategy And Evolution

Define the long-term vision for Finance and Operations platforms.
Develop a multi-year roadmap aligned with corporate objectives and the priorities of Finance functions and Construction business units.
Anticipate the evolution of financial practices, including payroll, accounts payable and receivable, accounting, procurement, project management, and construction operations.
Define the investments and priorities required to evolve the portfolio.
Maintain the right balance between business continuity, immediate needs, and future capabilities.

Finance And PMIS Transformation

Play a leading role in the design and deployment of the new financial system and future PMIS.
Ensure the continuity, stability, and evolution of CMiC and Procore throughout the transformation.
Plan the transition, data migration, integrations, and coexistence of current and future platforms.
Partner with Finance functions and Construction business units to transform processes and realize expected business benefits.
Prepare teams, operating models, and internal capabilities required to support the new platforms.
Manage risks, dependencies, and operational impacts associated with the transformation.

Practice Leadership

Lead the functional, technical, integration, and development teams responsible for the platforms.
Develop the internal capabilities required to operate and evolve the portfolio.
Oversee capacity planning and resource management for internal teams and external partners.
Foster a culture focused on service excellence, business partnership, accountability, and value creation.

Software Governance And Architecture

Establish functional and technical governance for the platforms within the portfolio.
Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and technology frameworks.
Provide direction on platform configurations, custom development, integrations, and extensions.
Collaborate with architecture, data, integration, and cybersecurity teams to ensure robust, secure, and scalable platforms.
Ensure consistency of processes, data, and integrations across the portfolio.

Delivery And Operational Performance

Be accountable for the availability, stability, security, and performance of the platforms.
Ensure initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and achieve expected outcomes.
Implement governance and performance monitoring mechanisms at the operational, tactical, and strategic levels.
Manage risks, issues, and dependencies across the portfolio.
Ensure the quality, adoption, and business value realization of deployed platforms.

Vendor And Partner Management

Define the strategy for leveraging software vendors, systems integrators, consultants, and specialized partners.
Manage relationships with strategic vendors and partners.
Participate in contract negotiations and agreement management.
Optimize value delivered by external partners and the cost of platforms and services.
Establish a sustainable balance between internal capabilities and external expertise.

This role could be for you if you have

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 10 years of experience managing complex enterprise platforms.
Significant experience with an ERP, financial system, or PMIS.
Experience with solutions supporting multiple financial functions, including accounting, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, procurement, and project financial management.
Strong understanding of financial and operational processes and their translation into integrated technology capabilities.
Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and external partners.
Experience managing large-scale transformation programs.
Experience in construction, infrastructure, or a project-based environment is considered a strong asset.
Experience in platform governance and strategic vendor management.

Key Competencies

Strategic leadership
Customer focus and value creation
Understanding of financial functions and processes, including payroll, accounts payable, and accounts receivable
Understanding of construction operations and project management
Enterprise platform management
Governance and portfolio management
Change and transformation management
Executive communication
Stakeholder influence and management
Vendor and partner management
Strategic thinking and decision-making
Collaboration and pragmatism

Benefits

RRSP with up to 5% employer matching
Hybrid work model for corporate roles
Employee stock ownership program
Career growth through real development opportunities
Transit pass reimbursement — get to work for free
Minimum 4 weeks of vacation from day one

For the past six years, we've proudly held the distinction of being one of Canada's Top 100 Employers.

Pomerleau is a national leader in construction, delivering major projects across Canada. We believe in creating a workplace where people feel respected, supported, and empowered to grow. Our culture is built on collaboration, trust, and a shared commitment to doing great work. If this speaks to you, apply for this role or connect with one of our recruiters to learn how we can support you throughout the process.

jobs.title: Client & Product Transformation | AVP to EVP
jobs.description:
Client & Product Transformation | AVP to EVP

Halifax, NS | Hybrid

Salary: $98,000 – $244,000 depending on level

Ref: 1127225

Your new company

Hays is partnering with a leading global financial services organization to recruit multiple professionals into its Client & Product Transformation team in Halifax.
These opportunities sit within a team focused on improving how services are delivered through transformation, technology, process optimization and operational improvement.

Your New Role

There are currently opportunities across four levels:
Assistant Vice President:
$98,000 – $128,000 | 6–8 years’ experience
Vice President:
$107,000 – $143,000 | 8–10 years’ experience
Senior Vice President:
$125,000 – $171,000 | 10+ years’ experience
Executive Vice President:
$176,000 – $244,000 | 12+ years’ experience

Depending on your experience and seniority, you will lead or support transformation initiatives across Investor Relations, Transfer Agency, AML and KYC.

You will work with clients and senior stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation, standardization, technology implementation and process improvement, while providing subject matter expertise within Investor Relations and/or AML/KYC.

At the more senior levels, responsibilities will also include leading strategic client engagements, managing service delivery and governance, identifying risks, and mentoring and developing team members.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

6+ years’ experience within Investor Relations, Transfer Agency, AML/KYC or Compliance
Experience delivering transformation, process improvement or operational change initiatives
Strong client-facing and stakeholder management experience
A track record of improving established processes and implementing technology-enabled solutions
Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills
Leadership and team management experience for the more senior positions
Strong knowledge of KYC/AML and regulatory requirements where relevant to your area of specialization
A professional qualification, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

What you’ll get in return

You’ll have the opportunity to join a global financial services environment where you can use your operational expertise while developing your career across transformation, technology and strategic client delivery.

These are hybrid positions based in Halifax, with salaries ranging from $98,000 to $244,000, depending on the level and your experience, alongside benefits, professional development support and flexible working arrangements.

What you need to do now

If you meet all the requirements for this role, please apply quoting reference number: 1127225, and indicate which level of position you are interested in. Thank you in advance for your interest.

We regret that we can only respond to candidates chosen for interview.

This posting is for an new vacancy with the organization.

AI may be used in the screening process for this role.

À propos de Pratt & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale.

Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.

Un employeur de choix

Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.

Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de Longueuil du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel.

Indicateurs de performance

Assurer la production mensuelle des indicateurs de performance du département
Faire évoluer les processus de données sur la qualité client selon les normes les plus récentes et les positionner pour l'avenir.
Diriger une petite équipe de développeurs Power BI responsables des rapports départementaux.

Automatisation des processus

Agir en tant qu’analyste d’affaire et responsable de produit
Assurer la gestion d’un fournisseur externe de services de gestion de données pour soutenir l'amélioration des processus
Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes de solutions technologiques (DT) ainsi que les développeurs afin de tester et implanter les solutions en production.
Prioriser les éléments du back log en fonction de la valeur d'affaires, des risques, du ROI et des dépendances techniques.
Soutenir les forums d'utilisateurs et responsables d'unité d'affaires des processus afin de collecter leur requis de nouvelle solution ou améliorations;
Être un agent de transformation pour influencer sur l’amélioration des processus d’affaires
Communiquer l'avancement des projets et justifier les choix de priorisation.
Coordonner et exécuter le plan de test / Identifier les problèmes de test et participer à l’investigation;
Offrir du support aux utilisateurs lors de l’exécution des tests ‘’User Acceptance Testing’’ (UAT);
Faire appel à des compétences de gestion de projets, de prise de décisions en connaissant les risques encourus ainsi que de communiquer à différents niveaux;
Être un agent de changement en préparation au déploiement des nouvelles solutions
Préparer et présenter du matériel de formation à la suite du déploiement des nouvelles solutions

Formation gestionnaire d’échappé

Préparer et présenter le contenu pour la communauté de Pratique pour les gestionnaires d’échappé
Assurer la gouvernance du profil de formation des gestionnaires d’échappé.

Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir ?

Doit être ingénieux, prendre de l’initiative et être un joueur d’équipe;
Bonne connaissance des processus d’affaires en lien avec le produit ;
Fortes habiletés interpersonnelles et de communication;
Esprit orienté vers la résolution de problèmes;
Expérience avec le service à la clientèle, investigation et retour de communication avec le client;
Un atout si vous connaissez déjà Databricks, Power BI, SAP, ENOVIA, Confluence, JIRA, SharePoint, MS Office 365;

Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une connaissance fonctionnelle de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre des instructions spécialisées, des plans, des dessins et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et parfois communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.

Travailler chez Pratt & Whitney Canada

Le masculin est utilisé sans discrimination et uniquement dans le but d’alléger le texte. Nous étudierons la demande d’emploi de tous les candidats qualifiés.

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, nous allions avec passion, audace et rigueur pour concevoir, fabriquer et entretenir les moteurs d’aéronefs les plus avancés et les plus fiables au monde. Notre travail et la qualité de nos produits contribuent au succès de nos clients, qui à leur tour sauvent des vies, soutiennent le commerce, connectent les communautés et protègent les libertés.

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, vous avez l’occasion de faire une différence tous les jours ; il suffit de lever les yeux. Êtes-vous prêt à vous dépasser ?

Le candidat retenu devra se soumettre à une vérification de ses antécédents judiciaires et obtenir toutes les autorisations nécessaires en lien avec la manipulation et le transfert de marchandises contrôlées. L’offre d’emploi est conditionnelle à la réussite de ces vérifications et à l’obtention des autorisations requises. Si ces conditions ne sont pas respectées, l’offre d’emploi sera retirée.

===============================================

About Pratt & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) is a global leader in aerospace innovation, proudly headquartered in Longueuil, Quebec, since 1928. We design and manufacture next-generation aircraft engines that power the world’s largest fleet of business, general aviation, and regional aircraft and helicopters.

For nearly 100 years, our teams have been at the forefront of propulsion technology, pushing boundaries to make flight more efficient and reliable. Our engines support missions that truly matter, from transporting people and essential goods, to enabling emergency medical services, humanitarian operations, and wildfire suppression around the world.

An Employer of Choice

Pratt & Whitney Canada was named one of Canada’s Best Employers for 2026 by Forbes, marking the 11th consecutive year the company has earned this recognition. Pratt & Whitney Canada also ranked #1 employer in the aerospace and defense industry in the country. In addition, our headquarters continue to be recognized among the top employers in the Montreal region. Together, these distinctions reinforce our reputation as an employer of choice in Montreal, across Canada, and around the world.

The position is based at our Longueuil location from Monday to Friday, with flexible hours and exclusively on-site.

Performance Indicators

Ensure the monthly production of departmental performance indicators.
Develop data processes related to customer quality in line with the latest standards and position them for the future.
Lead a small team of Power BI developers responsible for departmental reports.

Process Automation

Act as a business analyst and product owner.
Manage an external data management service provider to support process improvement.
Collaborate with technology solutions teams (DT) and developers to test and implement solutions in production.
Prioritize backlog items based on business value, risks, ROI, and technical dependencies.
Support user forums and business unit process leaders to gather their requirements for new solutions or improvements.
Act as a transformation agent to drive business process improvements.
Communicate project progress and justify prioritization decisions.
Coordinate and execute the test plan/identify testing issues and participate in investigations.
Provide support to users during User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
Utilize project management skills, make informed decisions understanding the associated risks, and communicate effectively across different levels.
Act as a change agent in preparation for the deployment of new solutions.
Prepare and deliver training materials following the deployment of new solutions.

Escape Management Training

Prepare and deliver content for the Community of Practice for Escape Leaders.
Ensure the governance of the training profile for Escape Leaders.

What do you need to succeed?

Must be resourceful, take initiative, and be a team player.
Strong knowledge of business processes related to the product.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Problem-solving-oriented mindset.
Experience in customer service, investigation, and providing customer feedback.
Experience with tools such as Databricks, Power BI, SAP, ENOVIA, Confluence, JIRA, SharePoint, MS Office 365 is an asset.

This position is part of a French-speaking work environment, it requires a very good knowledge of English to read and understand, on a daily basis, documentation and technical terms that may emanate from international organizations, as well as to write and communicate in English with customers, suppliers or international colleagues.

What do we offer?

Pension and savings plan with employer contributions
Group insurance program
Opportunities for advancement (career progression)
Merit or recognition program
Health and wellness program, including virtual health care
Recreational and sports club
Nearby daycares
Transportation accessibility or public transit program and free parking

Working at Pratt & Whitney Canada

The masculine pronoun is used without discrimination and solely for the purpose of making the text easier to read. We will consider applications from all qualified candidates.

At Pratt & Whitney Canada, we combine passion, boldness, and precision to design, manufacture, and maintain the most advanced and reliable aircraft engines in the world. Our work and the quality of our products contribute to the success of our customers, who in turn save lives, support commerce, connect communities, and protect freedoms.

At Pratt & Whitney Canada, you have the opportunity to make a difference every day—just look up. Are you ready to go beyond?

jobs.title: Regional Director, Digital Assets Sales & Commercialization, North America
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Regional Director, Digital Assets Sales & Commercialization, North America

Overview

Mastercard is seeking a highly strategic, commercially focused, and externally oriented Director, Regional Commercialization, Digital Assets to lead the growth, market expansion, and commercialization of Mastercard's BVNK solution across NAM Region. This sales executive will play a critical role in establishing Mastercard's leadership position in next-generation payments by driving adoption of Mastercard's stablecoin capabilities and BVNK-powered solutions.

He/she will define and execute the regional go-to-market strategy, shape ecosystem partnerships, and drive revenue growth across financial institutions, fintechs, payment service providers, marketplaces, digital merchants, and emerging payment innovators.

The successful candidate will serve as Mastercard's expert sales leader for accelerating the adoption and usage of MA’s BVNK solution opportunities, working closely with BVNK Senior Sales leadership, MA Regional Sales and Product leadership and account management teams, market development and MA Move teams to originate, structure, and accelerate strategic opportunities. The role requires balancing commercialization execution with long-term ecosystem development and strategic market expansion.

This is a highly visible expert sales role requiring deep expertise in payments, digital assets, cross-border flows, stablecoins, fintech ecosystems, and platform commercialization.

Role

The Director, Regional Commercialization, Digital Assets will be accountable for driving market adoption, revenue growth, and ecosystem expansion for BVNK and MA’s digital asset solutions across NAM Region.

The role serves as the BVNK expert sales leader connecting BVNK’s solutions, Mastercard's capabilities, and regional customer opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Commercialization

Define and execute the regional commercialization strategy for Mastercard's BVNK- powered solutions and stablecoin offerings
Collaborate with MA account teams to advance pipeline generation, strategic partnerships, client acquisition, and revenue realization.
Establish regional priorities, target segments, and market expansion strategies

Revenue Growth & Market Expansion

Lead targeted regional sales efforts focused on MA customer segments including financial institutions, fintechs, PSPs, remittance providers, marketplaces, merchants, and digital economy participants.
Develop and govern a robust pipeline of high-value opportunities while supporting deal progression from origination through contract execution, retention and growth.
Sponsor strategic pursuits and executive-level client engagements for priority opportunities.
Drive achievement of revenue, transaction volume, and market adoption goals across the region.
Identify new market opportunities, geographic expansion priorities, and emerging use cases that create sustainable growth.

Executive Client Engagement

Evangelize BVNK and MA’s digital assets and stablecoin-based payment solutions.
Build and maintain executive relationships with key Account Managers, clients, and ecosystem partners.
Provide stablecoin expert sales for strategic client discussions, executive briefings, workshops, and solution design engagements.
Support regional sales teams in navigating complex opportunities and executive-level negotiations.

Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development

Identify emerging partnership opportunities that accelerate adoption of Mastercard and BVNK’s digital asset capabilities.
Monitor competitive, regulatory, and market developments and translate insights into commercialization strategies.

Product & Market Development

Partner with BVNKs product teams to inform client insights, competitive analysis, product strategy, roadmap prioritization, market readiness decisions, and future product investments.
Develop regional growth strategies around key digital asset use cases, including:
Stablecoin-enabled cross-border payments
Remittances
Merchant payouts and settlement
Treasury and liquidity management
B2B payments
Disbursements
Marketplace payouts
Wallet funding and cash-out solutions
Assess market readiness and prioritize opportunities by country, client segment, use case, and revenue potential.

All About You

Required Qualifications

Significant experience leading commercialization, business development, product, or growth initiatives within payments, digital assets, fintech, cross-border payments, or financial technology.
Demonstrated ability to originate, negotiate, and close complex strategic partnerships and enterprise opportunities.
Deep understanding of the payments and financial services landscape across NAM Region .
Experience engaging and influencing C-level executives and senior decision-makers.
Ability to lead through influence across highly matrixed global organizations.
Strong executive presence with exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Demonstrated success operating within rapidly evolving and ambiguous market environments.
Ability to translate emerging technologies and market trends into commercial business opportunities.
Willingness to travel across the region.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in digital assets, stablecoins, blockchain-based payment infrastructure, or crypto-financial services.
Experience commercializing emerging or nascent payment technologies at scale.
Strong network across the banking, fintech, digital commerce, and payments ecosystem within the region.
Experience developing market-entry strategies and scaling new business lines globally or regionally.
Background in consultative sales, strategic partnerships, product leadership, or general management.

Success Measures

Success In This Role Will Be Measured By

Achievement of regional digital asset revenue and business growth objectives.
Strategic pipeline creation, conversion, and closed revenue.
Expansion of Mastercard's stablecoin and BVNK-powered solution adoption.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.

Pay Ranges

Toronto, Canada: $138,000 - $221,000 CAD
